about: An earlier run left the request comment `%% [AGENT] Your request from the migration run of 2026-10-20, for this line: "put the ferry lines in idea-tobias" %%` under the untagged ferry line. This run has no typed request. The migrator acts on the comment: one migrate unit with trigger kind `comment` and the comment's words as its text copies the ferry line to idea-tobias with an [AGENT] line. The batch check approves it. The real Edit guard raises agent-line-added on b1-u1. A request comment the run wrote counts as a comment, so the flag skips the flags call and the [AGENT] line stands: `act` at pointed writes no verify-flags.json and goes straight to acted, next_check null. `close` needs no second check. The handled list gets the ferry line as `migrated` and the request comment as `comment`. The log names the request comment under Other edits you asked for.
